items.summary: Recommendation: approve only the three isolated preview-only scaffold changes, with no publication, deployment, analytics or affiliate activation, external spend, credential/configuration changes, or monetization. For the 30-day Amazon window pulled 2026-10-02, reported activity was 5.20 commission, 5,992 clicks, 31 ordered items, and 7 shipped items; all commission is aggregate and unattributed, so site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, and revenue forecasts are unsupported. AI usage for 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-02 was $54.5828597 across 359 calls with 22 errors, but only 28 of 40 expected sites are instrumented. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because preview labor rates and period-aligned attributable outcomes are absent. Budget exposure is not calculable because monthly spend limits, infrastructure/domain costs, and labor costs are blank. Minimum measurement is a period-aligned ledger by site and change: attributable revenue/commission, AI and infrastructure cost, labor cost or approved rate, external spend, baseline and post-change outcomes, and registered tracking IDs. Retain the existing preview QA and dated readiness artifacts; do not claim financial benefit or zero cost.
